parts.text: Which claim correctly names the generative rule that continues the list?

options.text: Each term is $3$ more than the one before, so the next term is $16$.
The list looks neat, so no generative rule is needed to continue it.
Naming the next term is what creates the whole-number list in the first place.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The list grows by adding 3 each time, so the same rule gives 16 after 13.

teacher.key_rationale: Adding 3 each time is the generative rule that continues the list. Neat looks alone omit the rule. Claiming the naming creates the list reverses the relation.
